$comment: Register of every fixed value, default and fallback in CanDo (AGENTS rules 43 and 44, docs/22). tests/hardcoding/check_values.py fails when the code or the database holds one that is not here, or when this file names one that no longer exists. Change a list, a default or a fallback only in the same pull request as the code, with its class and source.

classes.system_status: A state CanDo's own workflow moves a record through. Code depends on every value; screens show each organization's wording through translations, never new values.
classes.engine_method: A way CanDo calculates, routes, matches or stores an entry. Each value has code behind it; the organization chooses among them (through a setting, a list category or the record itself) and a new value needs new code.
classes.published_vocabulary: Values defined by law, a government body or a published standard (CRA, Service Canada, Statistics Canada, Payments Canada, the statute). They change only when the publication changes.
classes.taxonomy: Fixed categories that CanDo's logic, reports or the law read. Organizations keep their own names and values in their own records (or in core.list_value) and map them to these categories.
classes.technical: Internal shape: what a row points to, where it came from, how it is stored or shown. No business meaning.
classes.initial_state: The first state of a workflow record (draft, pending, active). The workflow moves it on.
classes.counter: A count or running total that starts at zero.
classes.display_order: Where an item sorts on screen until the organization reorders it.
classes.law_until_exemption: The law applies until an exemption or a claim is recorded: tax, CPP, EI and overtime apply; TD1 amounts are nothing claimed. It errs on the side of compliance and the employee.
classes.safety: The most protective value for security or privacy (MFA on, restricted cases, the assistant off until approved). It can be loosened only where a setting allows.
classes.neutral_choice: The neutral value of an option with no legal or pay effect (a display flag, a feature not switched on, no adjustment). The organization sets it on the record.
classes.decided: Chosen by the product owner in a module review (cited).

fallbacks.when: An organization has not set a setting
fallbacks.then: CanDo's registered default for that setting (platform.setting_definition.default_value), shown on the setup screen as the default

fallbacks.when: A legal entity has no value of its own for a setting that can be set per employer
fallbacks.then: The organization's value, then FB-001

fallbacks.when: A setting has no CanDo default (decision_status pending) and the organization has not chosen
fallbacks.then: No fallback: SETTING_NOT_SET; setup cannot finish until the organization chooses

fallbacks.when: An insert leaves empty a column whose default is registered in platform.column_default
fallbacks.then: The organization's setting for it (or its main language or locale); any other empty value fails its constraint

fallbacks.when: A manager position is vacant and has no acting manager
fallbacks.then: Approvals go to the next filled position up the line, and HR is alerted to name an acting manager

fallbacks.when: Time in a request falls in minutes no manager's approval coverage includes
fallbacks.then: The line manager, or HR, as the policy's 'uncovered' says (setting approvals.uncovered_time)

fallbacks.when: An approver would approve their own request
fallbacks.then: The part goes to the approver's own approver; never self-approved (locked setting approvals.no_self_approval)

fallbacks.when: A rule value is marked verify_at_load, or is null (not yet researched)
fallbacks.then: No value is assumed: in production the rule set cannot be activated, and a calculation that needs it stops or warns with RULE_NOT_VERIFIED for HR

fallbacks.when: No rule edition covers the date
fallbacks.then: Stop: no calculation without a loaded edition

fallbacks.when: Two pay sources or premiums meet and the agreement says nothing about how they combine
fallbacks.then: Stop with UNRESOLVED_INTERACTION; labour relations completes the agreement version (first_in_order also needs the agreement's evaluation_order)

fallbacks.when: A cost has no explicit distribution
fallbacks.then: The assignment's, then the position's, then the org unit's distribution, then the suspense account with a task for finance

fallbacks.when: A cost is over a funding source's cap or not eligible for it
fallbacks.then: As the funding source's cap_behaviour says; new sources start from funding.default_cap_behaviour: move the excess to the fallback fund, with alerts at 90, 60 and 30 days
fallbacks.source: docs/17 §8.3; Owner, 27 Oct 2026 (Module 03 review, R6.2; closes Q12)

fallbacks.when: Retro or a correction reaches a funding source that has closed
fallbacks.then: The successor source, the fallback source or suspense, as the source's post_close_policy says

fallbacks.when: Migration 0008 meets relationship types created before it
fallbacks.then: They keep the purpose 0007 gave them (mentor: none; hrbp: hr_services; any other: supervision) until the organization reviews them at setup

fallbacks.when: A competency gap is worked out for a position
fallbacks.then: The latest assessment from the same position, else the latest from any position, from the sources in competencies.gap_sources; self-assessments are shown and never counted

fallbacks.when: A text has no version in the user's screen language
fallbacks.then: The text as the organization typed it (its main language), with a small tag showing its language (EN or FR). A language the organization keeps as required with no text is a data error (TRANSLATION_MISSING). Other versions come only from the organization or from CanDo's paid translation service

fallbacks.when: Migration 0008 meets an organization that had French switched on but has texts without French
fallbacks.then: French is kept as an optional language; a French-screen user sees the English text marked EN until French texts are added

fallbacks.when: A published code (NOC) has no title in the language asked
fallbacks.then: The published language's title, marked with its language (for example EN), until the French NOC is loaded

fallbacks.when: A title is needed for a purpose (posting, funder) that the position has no title for
fallbacks.then: The working title, then the job's title; the result says which one it is (origin)

fallbacks.when: A person in several positions is covered by two plans of one kind
fallbacks.then: HR decides which plan pays first for that person and records why; CanDo shows any order a plan contract sets (for example a union trust plan's) beside the decision, and never orders the plans itself
fallbacks.source: docs/20 §6.1; docs/16 Q37; Owner, 28 Oct 2026 (Module 05 review, R3.2; closes Q37)
fallbacks.where: benefits.enrolment.cob_rank with cob_decided_by and cob_reason; benefits.cob_decisions_needed()

fallbacks.when: A position ends and no benefit-change rule matches the enrolment
fallbacks.then: HR decides (hr_decides), with the statutory floor shown

fallbacks.when: An employer ends a position with notice owed and the jurisdiction's benefits-during-notice rule is not loaded
fallbacks.then: Stop with JURISDICTION_RULE_MISSING; a rule marked verify_at_load gives RULE_NOT_VERIFIED to HR

fallbacks.when: A person is covered by two agreements and a benefit-class or person-level rule must pick one
fallbacks.then: HR chooses the governing agreement for that person and records why; CanDo makes no automatic choice (GOVERNING_AGREEMENT_NOT_SET until HR decides)
fallbacks.source: docs/17 §7.7; docs/16 Q13; Owner, 28 Oct 2026 (Module 05 review, R3.1; closes Q13)

fallbacks.when: A payroll profile has no Indian Act s. 87 exemption recorded
fallbacks.then: Tax, CPP and EI apply (s87_status not_applicable) until HR records the exemption with its basis. Pre-boarding asks every new hire whether they claim it; a yes gives HR a task due before the first pay
fallbacks.source: Indian Act s. 87; requirements/03; Owner, 25 Oct 2026 (Module 02 review, F2)

fallbacks.when: A leave or time request names no positions
fallbacks.then: It covers every position the person holds that is active in the period

fallbacks.when: A one-time payment names no position
fallbacks.then: Refused until it names a position (payroll.one_time_allocation = assignment); an organization can choose to share unnamed payments by earnings instead

fallbacks.when: An employment's status is worked out on a date
fallbacks.then: The first category in employment.status_precedence held by a position that has not ended; no position on the date gives no status; a category missing from the precedence stops with EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_UNRESOLVED

fallbacks.when: An employee has no federal or provincial TD1 on file
fallbacks.then: Claim code 1: the basic personal amount, as CRA requires; HR is reminded to collect the form
fallbacks.source: CRA TD1 instructions; T4127; Owner, 25 Oct 2026 (Module 02 review, F1)

fallbacks.when: An approval part stays undecided
fallbacks.then: After approvals.escalate_after_working_days working days it also goes to the approver's own manager

fallbacks.when: An agreement gives less than the law on a standard the law does not let it replace
fallbacks.then: CanDo pays the law's minimum whatever is approved

fallbacks.when: A user's language has no screens yet
fallbacks.then: No substitution: the user is given a locale whose language has screens (INTERFACE_LANGUAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE otherwise); data, documents and notices follow the organization's data languages (FB-016)

fallbacks.when: A new organization is created
fallbacks.then: It starts with the starter lists (ref.list_starter) and English as the language it types its words in, unless it chooses French at setup (languages.starter); an organization with a Quebec work location keeps its words in French

fallbacks.when: A letter, email or document template has no version in the language the employee picked
fallbacks.then: It is sent in the language the template exists in; for an employee working in Quebec the French version must exist (FRENCH_REQUIRED_FOR_QUEBEC)

fallbacks.when: A probation counted on the calendar reaches its end date and no one has recorded a decision
fallbacks.then: The probation is passed on its end date and HR is told; the reminders before the end (probation.end_reminders_days) are there so this rarely happens

fallbacks.when: Migration 0009 meets an organization that keeps a language other than those of the starter texts as required for its data
fallbacks.then: Its starter routes, onboarding plans, posting channels and case kinds are not copied, and the migration says so; HR adds them with their texts or copies them once the texts can be completed

fallbacks.when: A pay statement or tax slip is issued and the person has made no delivery choice
fallbacks.then: A current employee gets it in CanDo self-service (no consent needed under CRA's rule); a former employee, or one on leave or laid off, gets it on paper unless they consented to electronic delivery; it is never emailed without email consent. A paper request always wins. Choices are per kind of document and can be withdrawn
fallbacks.source: Owner, 27 Oct 2026 (Module 03 review, R5.1, corrected the same day to follow CRA's rule)

fallbacks.when: A timesheet's facts match none of the organization's timesheet routes
fallbacks.then: Only its manager's approval is needed (no second approval); second approvals exist only where the organization adds a route

fallbacks.when: Migration 0014 meets reviews written before it
fallbacks.then: They are marked rated and keep their ratings and overall method; the 90-day rule and the reasons apply when a rating is next changed
fallbacks.source: Owner, 28 Oct 2026 (Module 07 review, confirmed after the write-up)

fallbacks.when: Migration 0016 meets plans made before it
fallbacks.then: They are marked org_chart plans, the only feature that made plans before 0016; position plans and workforce plans start with 0016
fallbacks.source: Owner, 29 Oct 2026 (Module 09 review, confirmed after the write-up)
